fact: A joint CNAR, PURS and ANID mission began on 10 May 2024 in Dapaong to register new Burkinabe asylum seekers and distribute identification cards to displaced people already enrolled, running 2 May to 29 August 2024 across several regions.
title: OPERATION D'ENREGISTREMENT ET DE DISTRIBUTION DE CARTES AUX DEMANDEURS D'ASILE
